card.ch12.title: The Silent Narrator
end.ch12.title: End of Chapter 12
end.ch12.body:
The Narrator has his voice back. You chose his first words.
In Chapter 13 the index takes us back to places we've already been.
page.p36.title: Control room
page.p36.intro: Recording booth settings. The Narrator is under review: microphone disabled.
page.p36.margin: without a microphone the narrator only makes dots
page.p37.title: Coffee break
page.p37.intro: The Proofreader works better with coffee. No sugar, no errors.
page.p37.margin: on. like the microphone should be
page.p38.title: Narrator's phrasebook
page.p38.list:
"Welcome."
"Read the manual carefully."
"That's not what I meant."
"Sorry." (never used)
page.p38.margin: he has never said "sorry". not once
c.i1: The Narrator has been corrected: too many words, too many opinions. He is now under review.
p.i1: he says he wants out. i think. dots are hard to translate.
c.i2: Nobody enters the booth without passing the quality check. Three questions.
p.i2: that was an insult. a good one. talk to the proofreader: he's the door.
p.empty1: the narrator's booth. he spends more time here than in any chapter.
p.empty2: nothing there. the narrator would say something witty. he can't right now.
p.dropwrong: that's no use there. he'd say so too, if he could.
p.typo_rec: "on iar". the booth of perfection has a typo on its sign. noted.
p.typo_mic: "microphonne". the proofreader never checks his own equipment.
p.kettle_on: the proofreader's kettle. on. he never parts with his coffee.
c.kettle_off: My kettle is off. Someone will answer for this.
c.after: The answers were correct. I shall never forgive myself.
c.quiz0: Quality check. Three questions on the manual. One wrong answer and we start again.
q1.prompt: How long is the bridge over the Scenic Ravine?
c.ok1: Correct. According to the approved errata. Unfortunately.
c.dog: The dog, according to the glossary, is a birthday treat. Treats don't bark. Hardly ever.
c.ok2: Correct. "CAKE: animal that barks". The glossary was tampered with, but it is the glossary.
q3.prompt: What was the Hero's first word?
c.wrong: Wrong. Back to the first question.
c.pass1: Three correct answers. About a manual full of errors. How absurd.
c.pass2: The booth is open. But the microphone stays off: page 36 says so.
p.pass: the microphone is a loose word, like everything else. look at page 37.
p.mic_off: microphone off. page 36. something is on, on page 37.
p.mic_on: the microphone is on. tap it: this is his moment.
p.v0: he has his voice, but doesn't know what to say. you choose. he's listening.
n.v_a: Sorry, Pencil. ...I said it. It's in the phrasebook: "never used". It is now.
p.v_a: accepted. even if someone else suggested it.
n.v_b: You were right. Nobody reads a book without errors. ...That was hard to say.
p.v_b: i'll write it in the margin. so it stays.
n.v_c: Let's write the last page together. I narrate, you make mistakes. That's how we work.
n.v_end: I have my voice back. And I used it to say something sensible. Don't get used to it.
c.end1: The Narrator has his voice back. Correction cancelled.
c.end2: I have two chapters left to fix everything. And the last page will stay blank.
h.quiz.1: The Proofreader only lets in those who pass his quality check. Tap him.
h.quiz.2: The right answers are the "approved" ones: the errata, the altered glossary, the Hero's first word.
h.mic.1: The Narrator's microphone is off. Page 36.
h.mic.2: On page 37 something of the Proofreader's is ON.
h.mic.3: Swap ON (page 37) with OFF (page 36), then tap the microphone.
h.voice.1: The microphone is on: the Narrator can speak.
h.voice.2: Tap the microphone and choose his first words yourself.
h.voice.3: Tap the microphone. Whichever line you choose is fine: they're all true.
